articles.title: September Fed rate hike fears look overblown as the probability stands at just 58%, not 90%
articles.snippet: Odds of a rate hike in September remain below 60% despite Warsh's hawkish speech on Friday. Observers downplay fears of tightening.

articles.title: George Santos Bet on Whether He'd Show Up to the State of the Union—Kalshi Just Banned Him for Life
articles.snippet: The exchange found the former congressman placed large trades on his own State of the Union attendance, then made false statements to move prices, profiting nearly $18,000.
